# llm-cache-layers

> Reproducible benchmark of cost, latency and error rate for prompt cache, exact cache, semantic cache and a semantic cache gated by a status store, in a question-answering assistant. Python with no dependencies to run; raw results included. Questions and store rules are in Brazilian Portuguese; documentation is in English.

Read AGENTS.md before operating the repository. The `run` and `calibrate` commands of lab.py make paid API calls; `simulate`, `project` and analyze.py do not.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): summary of the experiment and the results
- [docs/REPORT.md](docs/REPORT.md): technical report with method, tables, charts, cost model and limitations
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, rules, commands, result file format and how to extend

## Code

- [lab.py](lab.py): workload generation, scenarios A to G, API calls, simulation and projection
- [analyze.py](analyze.py): Markdown tables and charts in docs/img from results/

## Data

- [data/system_prompt.md](data/system_prompt.md): system prompt with the rules of a fictional store (Portuguese)
- [data/questions.json](data/questions.json): frequent questions in four phrasings, personal questions and fictional customers (Portuguese)
- [prices.json](prices.json): prices per million tokens used in the calculation, with source and date
- results/*-rows.jsonl: one row per request, with tokens, answer source, correctness and cost
- results/*-summary.json: parameters and totals per scenario
- results/*.sqlite: final group status in scenarios F and G

## Optional

- [README.pt-BR.md](README.pt-BR.md): summary in Portuguese
- [.env.example](.env.example): required environment variables
- [requirements.txt](requirements.txt): dependency for the charts
